verdict.rationale: The only first-party API evidence is the ES|QL REST endpoint, which documents request-body parameters (filter, time_zone, locale) and output formats for querying telemetry. Nothing in the pack shows API coverage for the other UI capabilities (dashboards, SLOs, Cases, alerting rules, Fleet, Discover), and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at the checked paths. missing for 10: documented API coverage for SLOs, cases, alert rules, dashboards and agent management, a published OpenAPI spec, any statement of UI/API parity, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
